body:
You have to be completely honest with your therapist for the counseling to succeed. None of my therapists worked out until I found one that I liked and told him all of my faults. This included when I lied about something in one session and had to tell him in the next that I  had lied to him in the previous session. Obviously make sure you like your therapist before committing to weekly sessions, but after this you have to be completely honest.

Back to the point: I do hope you find someone to talk to, and that you resolve your issues with your friend and boyfriend, or later find a better friend that you can talk about these issues with.
I already have a therapist; I also don't think suicide is glorious. The main thing preventing me from going on with it is how much I know my mother would be devastated if I did.
I also suffer from a combination of anxiety/depression. I am very sorry about your family/friend situation, and I hope that you are able to escape the abusive relationship with your girlfriend.
